title: Restriction atom correspondence
statement: For each $n$, the set of atoms consisting of a subset $J$ of coordinates together with a sign in $\{\pm1\}$ at every coordinate outside $J$ is in bijection with the assignments of a restriction state (free, fixed at $1$, or fixed at $-1$) to each coordinate. The bijection associates to an atom the restriction that is free on $J$ and fixed according to the atom's sign at every coordinate outside $J$.
